title: Novel marine diatom ssRNA virus NitRevRNAV infecting Nitzschia reversa
author: Toyoda, Kensuke
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Isolate clonal Nitzschia reversa
steps.instruction: Collect natural seawater and isolate Nitzschia reversa cells to obtain a clonal host culture.

steps.title: Inoculate filtrate onto host
steps.instruction: Take aliquots of seawater filtrates and inoculate the clonal N. reversa culture; incubate until the host reaches exponential growth.

steps.title: Harvest lysate as virus suspension
steps.instruction: Collect the resulting lysate from the infected, exponentially‑growing host culture and treat it as a clonal virus suspension.

steps.title: Use virus suspension for analyses
steps.instruction: Employ the clonal virus suspension in downstream biochemical studies as required.
